purpose: WP-6 local LLM engine: llama.cpp server build and one small GGUF instruct model. Owner approved these two downloads. Verified with the publisher's published sha256 before use (scripts/llm_local.py verify).

engine.name: llama.cpp
engine.asset_sha256_source: GitHub releases API, asset field digest (sha256:a45a6afd...), checked against the downloaded file
engine.build: CPU, x86_64 Linux, GCC 11.4.0; no CUDA/ROCm/Vulkan/SYCL backend
engine.extract_into: the archive top folder is llama-b11552/; extract into <bin-dir> so the server is at <bin-dir>/llama-b11552/llama-server

model.label: Qwen2.5 1.5B Instruct (Q4_K_M GGUF)
model.publisher: Qwen (Alibaba Cloud), GGUF conversion published by the Qwen organisation
model.sha256_source: Hugging Face LFS oid of the file in the Qwen repository (api/models/Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct-GGUF/tree/main), checked against the downloaded file
model.chat_template: embedded in the GGUF (used through llama-server --jinja)
